visual.description: Duel-mode butterfly comparison. Left: 'Recycled Polyester' (marketed as green), Right: 'Virgin Polyester'. Center metric: BPA content — 13.5 vs 7.66 ng/g. Recycled bar extends further left (Accent Pink), Virgin bar extends right (Accent Blue). Below: 'Recycling concentrates plastic residues' annotation. Above the duel: 'Sports Bras & Athletic Shirts: 22–40× Prop 65 Limit' as a separate callout card in Negative Red border.
visual.sourceText: Source: Jurikova et al., Environ. Sci. Pollut. Res., 2024

notes: Butterfly/duel comparison for recycled vs virgin polyester. The 'greener choice' having nearly double the BPA is the insight. Sports bra Prop 65 stat adds urgency — consider a small warning-style card above the duel chart. Flat surface for clean readability.
